Subject: DPIA evidence request for onboarding (Art. 28/30)

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. As part of our legal & privacy onboarding checklist we need the following items to complete our DPIA review and internal Procurement sign-off:

- Article 30 processing register extract for the last 12 months (CSV preferred)
- A short summary (1–2 pages) of Redwood's DPIA / data flow assumptions for our use case (PHI tokenization + embeddings)
- Processor security annex (encryption/KMS, retention, deletion procedures)
- Confirmation of audit rights and typical lead times for evidence requests

Can you share an estimated delivery ETA? We're aiming to close intake by 2026-05-20. If you need an NDA or escalation to legal, let me know.

Appreciate it,
Ava Jensen
VP, Privacy & Compliance
Tectonic Health

Subject: RE: DPIA evidence request for onboarding (Art. 28/30)

Ava — thanks for the clear list. Please find the initial packet attached and linked. We compiled the requested items scoped to your PHI tokenization + embeddings use case.

What we included:
- article30-register-extract.csv (sanitized export; includes transfer flags and retention fields)
- dpia-summary-for-audit.pdf (1.5 pages; scope, data flows, key mitigations, residual risk assessment)
- processor-security-annex.docx (draft language covering KMS, encryption-in-transit/at-rest, retention/deletion cycle, and audit rights)

Delivery notes and next steps:
- Audit rights: our standard approach is to provide evidence exports, access to ledger extracts, and a rolling 30-day window for live logs or a scheduled on-site/remote audit with two weeks' notice. If Tectonic requires a broader onsite audit clause, Legal will need to review and we may propose a scoped SOC2+ questionnaire instead.
- DPIA assumptions: the summary lists two assumptions about tokenization (we treat tokens as irreversible one-way pseudonyms unless customer opts for reversible token storage) — please confirm if your implementation will store reversible tokens or if Redwood will be used as a transient transformer only.
- Subprocessors / transfers: the register flags subprocessors that transfer outside the EU. We have SCCs in place for infra partners; if you have an internal legal team contact, we'll route the processor annex for redlines.

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cDP1AqEvidence (packet)
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234/deal/4721

Let us know if you'd like a short 30 minute meeting to walk through the packet. If Tectonic confirms the reversible-token decision and sign-off on the annex language we can finalize the DPA addendum next week.

Best,
Irene Choi
Head of Privacy Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: article30-register-extract.csv; dpia-summary-for-audit.pdf; processor-security-annex.docx
